ios.desc:
SuppSnitch is your smart supplement scanner & vitamin tracker. Instantly reveal ingredients, side effects, and trusted quality ratings in your supplements. Uncover the Truth. SuppSnitch is your personal supplement detective.

Tired of confusing supplement labels and bold marketing claims? With SuppSnitch, you can scan any supplement to uncover what’s really inside your vitamins, protein powders, or herbal blends. Stop guessing and get clear, science based insights. We analyze hundres of resources and AI to give you the juicy details, helping you make safer, smarter, and more informed decisions about your health.

With SuppSnitch Supplement Scanner, you can finally see beyond the marketing hype.

KEY FEATURES:

► INSTANT SUPPLEMENT SCANNER • Use your phone’s camera to scan the any vitamin, protein powder, herbal extract, or supplement. •  Just 2 Photos of your supplements is all we need and Our smart search will do the rest.
► DEEP INGREDIENT ANALYSIS (FORMULA) • Discover the purpose of every single ingredient, from active compounds like Organic Chlorella and Cilantro to the inactive fillers. • Get clear explanations of what each ingredient does and how it contributes to the supplement's effects, such as "Heavy Metal Detoxification Support" or "Antioxidant Support."
► CRUCIAL CAUTIONS & WARNINGS • Stay safe and informed. We flag potential issues the label might miss. • Get alerts for potential side effects, allergen & contaminant warnings, and critical drug interaction advisories. • Understand proper dosage and usage warnings to avoid common mistakes.
► EXPERT VERDICT: PROS & CONS • Is your supplement worth it? Our team of experts provides an unbiased verdict, breaking down the key pros and cons of each product. • We analyze ingredient quality, dosage effectiveness, and overall value.
► REGULATORY & QUALITY INSIGHTS • Don't get fooled by fancy labels. We dig into the details you care about. • Check the FDA Advisory Status for your supplement. • Verify Manufacturing Quality, including certifications like cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice), to ensure your product is made in a quality-controlled facility. • Learn if the product uses certified Organic Ingredients.
► BUILD YOUR PERSONAL COLLECTION • Save supplements you scan to your personal collection. • Easily track your daily regimen, compare products, and access your favorite supplement reports anytime.
► DISCOVER & LEARN WITH ARTICLES • Expand your health knowledge with our growing library of expert

quotes.text:
I built an iOS app that scans supplement bottles (back and front photo) and uses AI to break down ingredients, flag possible risks and expose certifications (like claims to be vegan but actually not).

Would love feedback on the app.

App Store link -https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749311781
